# Symbols that must not be re-exported from the OCCT libraries, passed to ld as
# -unexported_symbols_list (macOS). One glob per line, Mach-O spelling (leading underscore).
#
# FreeType is linked statically into libTKService and would otherwise re-export ~220 FT_* symbols. ELF and
# Mach-O both have a flat namespace, so a process that loads another FreeType -- matplotlib, Pillow and Qt all
# bundle one, and on Linux OCCT itself pulls a second one in through fontconfig -- can bind OCCT's calls to
# that one instead (CadQuery/ocp-build-system#54).
#
# Until 2026-09-25 this was done by patching FreeType's own header (deps/hide-freetype-symbols.sh, removed):
# the same effect, but it modified a dependency, which has to be re-checked at every bump and has to be
# declared in NOTICE as a modified copy. Doing it at link time leaves the dependency pristine.
#
# FreeImage needs nothing here: it is a shared library built with -fvisibility=hidden, so it exports only its
# own FreeImage_* API and none of its bundled codecs (deps/build-freeimage-macos.sh).
# Measured against the unpatched static libfreetype.a: 203 _FT_*, 15 _FTC_*, 2 _TT_* and nothing else.
_FT_*
_FTC_*
_TT_*
